reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "That's a big shift to be working through, and it's a fair thing to ask. Menopause can affect sleep, recovery and energy, so training often has to flex a bit. Most people do well keeping strength work in the plan, since it helps protect muscle and bone. For anything specific to your body or symptoms, a doctor who knows your history is the right person to talk to. When you're ready, tell me how many days a week you can train, how long each session is, and what gear you have, and I'll build you a program around that."}
